name: Clipboard Search
description: Remembers recently copied text (in memory only) and finds it again.

intents.name: search_clipboard
intents.description: Find a previously copied piece of text in the clipboard history and copy it again
patterns: (what did i copy|find what i copied) about {query}

query.description: Words or topic of the copied text to find

intents.name: clipboard_history
intents.description: Show the most recent clipboard history entries

intents.name: clear_clipboard_history
intents.description: Forget the clipboard history kept by the assistant
